mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_event (id, occurred_at, realm, tenant_id, actor_id, category, action, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, error_code, detail, service, trace_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{occurredAt}, #{realm}, #{tenantId}, #{actorId}, #{category}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{outcome}, #{errorCode}, CAST(#{detail} AS jsonb), #{service}, #{traceId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.occurred_at, a.category, a.action, a.actor_id, p.account AS actor_account, p.display_name AS actor_name, a.resource_type, a.resource_id, a.outcome, a.error_code, CAST(a.detail AS text) AS detail, a.service, a.trace_id
ORDER BY a.occurred_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
